---
title: "mtcars Dashboard"
format: dashboard
theme: cosmo
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)

Data <- mtcars
```

## Row {height="20%"}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Cars in dataset"
#| icon: car-front
#| color: primary
list(value = nrow(Data))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Average MPG"
#| icon: speedometer2
#| color: success
list(value = round(mean(Data$mpg), 1))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Average HP"
#| icon: lightning-charge
#| color: warning
list(value = round(mean(Data$hp), 0))
```

## Row {height="80%"}

### Column {width="33%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Cars by Cylinder Count"
Data %>%
  count(cyl) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(cyl), y = n, fill = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Cylinders", y = "Number of cars") +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Column {width="33%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Distribution of MPG"
ggplot(Data, aes(mpg)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 10, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  labs(x = "Miles per gallon", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Column {width="34%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Horsepower vs. MPG"
p <- ggplot(Data, aes(x = hp, y = mpg, color = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(x = "Horsepower", y = "MPG", color = "Cylinders") +
  theme_minimal()
ggplotly(p)
```
